usageNotes: Use this to restart Ceph services on a specific node after configuration changes, daemon failures, or as part of a troubleshooting workflow. Omitting the `service` parameter restarts the entire `ceph.target` unit (all Ceph services on the node); pass a specific service name (e.g., `mon.pve1`) to restart only that daemon. The call returns a task UPID string — poll it with the task status endpoint to confirm completion before performing dependent operations.

examples.summary: Restart all Ceph services on node pve1

tips: Restarting `ceph.target` briefly interrupts I/O on all OSDs on that node; ensure Ceph health is HEALTH_OK and PGs are active+clean before restarting to avoid degraded state.
To restart only the monitor daemon on pve1, set service to `mon.pve1` — this is less disruptive than restarting the full target.
The returned UPID can be tracked via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status.
